column3: MT 14:3. NKJV renders “take [what is] good” as “Receive us graciously,” and “let us pay [as] bulls our lips” as “we will offer the sacrifices of our lips.”
MT 14:5. Close to the Hebrew; “voluntarily” is rendered “freely,” and “their apostasy” “their backsliding.”
MT 14:6. Close to the Hebrew; “strike its roots” is rendered “lengthen his roots.”
MT 14:8. Close to the Hebrew; “they will make grain grow” is rendered “They shall be revived like grain,” and “its memorial” “Their scent.”
MT 14:9. NKJV supplies “Ephraim shall say” before “What have I to do anymore with idols?”, and renders “I will answer and watch over him” as “I have heard and observed him.”
MT 14:10. Close to the Hebrew; “discerning” is rendered “prudent.”
